Johnny Ho PhD candidate in imaging informatics [resume]

I am a PhD student in the UCLA Medical Imaging Informatics, advised by Professor Corey Arnold, and Professor Alex Bui.

I am passionate about machine learning and deep learning. I love exciting projects that involve: (1) thinking (i.e., develop algorithms), (2) implementation (i.e., programming in industry standard), and (3) meaning (i.e., the application that I am building have large impact to the company and the society)
